sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday, looking to extend their excellent recent form that has seen them win four of their last five matches. Alsager arrive in poor shape, occupying the bottom three with just one win from their last six outings, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to consolidate their 1st-place position with a two-point cushion over Stafford Town.
divisionWide: The title race remains tight at the top: Stafford Town, currently 2nd with 20 points, travel to Dawley Town in a fixture where they'll be expected to pick up points after a recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, 3rd with 19 points, host Eccleshall in what should be a competitive match between two strong sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home and will be looking to maintain their winning form. Elsewhere, in-form Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) host Foley Meir, while struggling Widnes Town visit Brereton Social in a clash between sides with limited recent success. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a match between mid-table sides with inconsistent records. Shawbury United, winless in their last five, host Barnton, who have drawn two of their last three. Cheadle Heath Nomads, picking up consecutive draws recently, visit Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's lower-ranked sides. Crewe, on a poor run, face Allscott Heath at home in a match between struggling outfits.
